soldier: Head yellowish brown, the thorax, abdomen and legs pale yellow; small hairs scattered over the face, the pilosity of the thorax and abdomen dense. Head oval, longer than wide, the posterior margin arcuate. The inner margin of the left mandible bears a large marginal tooth at one-third from the anterior end and an upward tooth-like projection at the base; the inner margin of the right mandible has a minute tooth-like projection at two-thirds from the anterior end. Labrum lingulate, reaching the middle of the mandibles, arcuate at the sides and raised in the middle, the apical setae and the lateral setae distinct and equal in length, and behind the subapical setae five straight setae on each side regularly arranged along the side of the labrum. Postmentum short and stout, projecting from the ventral surface of the head, narrow anteriorly and broad posteriorly, the sides nearly parallel. Antennae with 16–17 segments, mostly 17, segments 3, 4 and 5 shorter, segments 3 and 4 together slightly shorter than segment 2, segments 4 and 5 together equal to or slightly longer than segment 2, the tip of the terminal segment pointed, straight and slightly long. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the median concavity of the anterior margin distinctly deeper than that of the posterior margin, with setae around the periphery.
